source.name: Vaulted Values X — Cameraman Tower Defense Value List (After Update 4)
source.note: Trade values between units, not gem prices. Numbers are read from the video's spoken list.

tv-spider.story: Update 3's new exclusive. Listed at 6,000, peaked near 8,800, dipped to about 7,250, and was back at 8,000 on the October 25 list. It and Engineer Cameraman are the only top units that rose after both updates.

chaos-cameraman.story: Went from 7,500 to a 9-10,000 range in under a day, gave all of it back in under three days, and has sat at 7,000 since October 23. The only top-10 entry marked dropping.

engineer-cameraman.story: Gained about 10% after Update 3 and climbed from 3,500 to a 4,200 peak on October 22, then held 4,000 from October 23. Carries 8/10 demand.

executioner-tv-man.story: First appeared as 'OC owner's choice' before it had a number, listed at 5,000 on October 20, and fell to 3,200. Demand is 3.5/10, the second lowest in the top ten, which makes it slow to trade away at full value.

upgraded-titan-cameraman.story: Listed at 3,500, dropped to 2,500 within 14 hours, then climbed back to 2,850. A premium pass alone at 2,550 comes up 300 short of it.

headless-tv-man.story: Listed at 4,000 and halved to 1,900 in under two days. Demand was 10/10 on day one, 6 that night, 3 two days later, and 2 on October 25.

titan-cinemaman.story: Rose from 330 before Update 4 to 460, and carries 8/10 demand.

tv-woman.story: Listed at 700 after Update 3, fell to 480, climbed to 800, was 680 before Update 4, and sat at 450 on October 25 - ten points under Titan Cinemaman.

upgraded-videotapper-prototype.change: lost a fifth to a quarter since Update 4
upgraded-videotapper-prototype.story: Lost a fifth to a quarter of its value since Update 4 and is still under where it sat before the patch.

upgraded-titan-speakerman.change: lost a fifth to a quarter since Update 4
upgraded-titan-speakerman.story: The cheapest mythic on the list. At 250 it is worth exactly fifty of the old legendaries at 5 points each.

large-scientist-cameraman.story: Doubled from 125 to 250 after one small dip, climbing four times in a row. Carries the same 8/10 demand as Engineer Cameraman at 4,000.

pumpkin-farmer.story: Marked unstable on the October 25 list.

camera-repair-drone.story: First listed at 120 and was down to 50 by October 25.

dragon-cameraman.story: A Halloween crate unit. Went from 120 to about 325 the same day, then collapsed to 40.

scientist-cameraman.story: Swung from 30 to 60 and back to 35 in two days.

titan-tv-man.story: One of the old legendaries, cut to 5 points each on the October 25 list.

titan-cameraman.story: One of the old legendaries, cut to 5 points each on the October 25 list.

titan-speakerman.story: One of the old legendaries, cut to 5 points each on the October 25 list.

ninja-cameraman.story: One of the old legendaries, cut to 5 points each on the October 25 list.

laser-cameraman-car.story: One of the old legendaries, cut to 5 points each on the October 25 list.

upgraded-titan-tv-man.story: Arrived with Update 5 on 4 November 2026 and was already the most valuable Godly on the 10 November list. There is no earlier list to compare against, so this page carries one reading rather than a trend.
